anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: In him all things have been created.
Male, perfect, yearling, unblemished, first month, tenth.

choices.why: The decade as fullness of the one-rule; keep the word.

lemmas.lexica: Lampe: monarchy, often of the Father

pass_a_gloss: For as those were pre-typed in a male sheep, so we in a human being who is as a lamb; as in a perfect one, so we in his fullness, he having perfected the fatherly will; as in a yearling, so in an end of ages — for as the year is completing of months, so he too is completing of law and prophets — as in an unblemished one, so in a sinless one; as in a first month, so in a beginning of all creation, in which all things have been created; on a tenth, in fullness of monarchy.
pass_b_english: For as those were prefigured in a male sheep, so we in a human being who is as a lamb. As in a perfect one, so we in his fullness, he having completed the Father's will. As in a yearling, so at the end of ages — for as the year is a completing of months, so he too is a completing of law and prophets. As in an unblemished one, so in one without sin. As in the first month, so in the beginning of all creation, in which all things have been created. On the tenth, in the fullness of monarchy (Colossians 1:16) (Exodus 12:3–5) (John 1:29) (Colossians 1:19) (Colossians 2:9) (John 17:4) (Matthew 5:17) (1 Corinthians 10:11) (Galatians 4:4).
